summary_markdown:
A new virtual facility mapping has been implemented in the database, changing how data is processed. The discussion focused on recalculating historical data using this new mapping. It was proposed whether to use a start date of June 1st or July 1st for the recalculation period.

Regarding unique identifiers (uniques), [me] confirmed that they will be migrated as is, but the devices/sessions coefficient should use real data first. Virtual data should only be used if real data is unavailable or insufficient in the sample.
decisions: The recalculation start date for facility data mapping needs confirmation (June 1st vs July 1st).
action_items: Confirm the historical data recalculation start date.
